reality: Removes price signal that would expose abstraction; 30M unmetered pumps; Punjab water table falls 1m/yr; politically untouchable

official_narrative: Disbursement headlines claimed at scheme outlay (JJM ₹8.69 L cr; AMRUT ₹2.99 L cr)
reality: Loss between announcement and outcome runs ₹3-5K cr/yr — comparable to entire Indian + foreign philanthropy + impact-finance water layer combined
why_it_matters: Closing capture is higher-leverage than expanding philanthropic envelope; tools = third-party audit + functionality-tied disbursement + asset durability monitoring

dynamic: Dark data — ~40% exists but not findable

reality: OCEMS legally restricted; State PHED in PDFs without URL persistence; municipal billing locked; CPCB raw data behind dashboards with no CSV export; tribunal evidence files unpublished
why_it_matters: Most consequential datasets — abstraction discharge compliance urban demand tribunal hydrology JJM functionality — are exactly the ones that are dark

dynamic: Lag tax — measurement vs decision cycle
official_narrative: Annual scheme allocation cycle; weekly reservoir bulletin; daily JJM dashboard
reality: CGWB GEC: 12-18 mo lag · CPCB annual: 6-12 mo · Wetland Atlas: 13+ years stale · NMCG STP: 6+ months · JJM functionality unmeasured
why_it_matters: Annual budget cycles reach for last-fiscal-year data; two-year-old GW classification is the input for next-year allocation; lag is a feature not an accident

reality: 40-55% functional rate under post-warranty O&M; definition slippage: counted at installation not continuous service; aggregated FTK water-quality not consistently published
why_it_matters: 30-40% of new connections likely non-functional by 2032 without O&M financing; ₹2-3K cr/yr CapEx at risk; 16th Finance Commission Mar 2026 is the bet-the-farm signal

dynamic: Caste in water access — not disaggregated
official_narrative: JJM + AMRUT report by district + GP + village; CGWB by block
reality: Caste determines water access land ownership and market power across rural India; no partner names this explicitly; data is not disaggregated by social group; manual scavenging fatalities ~hundreds annually almost entirely Dalit
why_it_matters: Most water-stressed are also most politically marginal; constituency that benefits from transparency is structurally absent at every layer

official_narrative: Cauvery 2018 SC allocation; Krishna KWDT-II 2010; Godavari 1980/2014; Indus 1960
reality: Every existing water deal was signed under climate stationarity assumptions that are already wrong; within 20 years every major water deal needs renegotiation under stress
why_it_matters: No institutional muscle for renegotiation; tribunals litigate not govern; River Boards Act 1956 dormant for 70 years; climate-water adaptation is unaddressed reform layer

official_narrative: BWSSB supplies; AMRUT + Smart Cities promised ward-level transparency
reality: Per-capita potable water at ward scale not answerable in any Indian city; ward-level supply data from utility billing is locked; NRW at 30-50% across major utilities
why_it_matters: The deliverable is missing; a single high-profile audit of one Tier-1 city utility would shift the equilibrium; Bengaluru 2024-25 near-Day-Zero is the constituency-formation event waiting to happen
